info.screen.roleid.green:
Civilian
Alice... where are you..

Skill - Return Everyone to Rooms: usable while your SAN is above 70, once per round for the whole lobby.
Teleports every player back to their own room and makes every role whose SAN can be reduced lose 50 SAN.

While your SAN is below 30, a bare-handed left click knocks the target back but never deals any damage.

You spawn with a book and quill; it is dropped on the ground when you die.

Shop: Mania (150 coins) - instantly sets your own SAN to 0.
